# netbox_permission (Data Source)

Retrieves a single permission from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_permission" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "permission_id" {
  value = data.netbox_permission.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the permission.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (List of String) The actions of the permission.
- `constraints` (String) The constraints of the permission.
- `description` (String) A description of the permission.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the permission.
- `groups` (List of Number) The IDs of the groups of the permission.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `object_types` (List of String) The object types of the permission.
- `users` (List of Number) The IDs of the users of the permission.
